title: CPL Live Score 2026: Live Match, Scorecard and Results
description: Follow the CPL 2026 live score with automatic match status, innings scores, overs, recent results, upcoming fixtures and links to full scorecards.
headline: Every ball. One command centre.
lede: Follow the current Caribbean Premier League match with verified score updates, innings state, match status and direct access to the full scorecard.
source_note: Scores are shown only after the official feed confirms them. If the feed is interrupted, the last verified state remains visible.

faq.question: Does the CPL live score update automatically?
faq.answer: Yes. The live-score page checks the verified CPL match feed every 15 seconds while the page is visible. You can also request an immediate refresh.

faq.question: What appears before a CPL match starts?
faq.answer: Before the toss, the page shows the confirmed fixture, venue, start time and a countdown. Scores, playing XIs and innings details remain pending until the official feed publishes them.

faq.question: What happens if the official score feed is unavailable?
faq.answer: The page keeps the last verified state on screen and clearly marks the connection issue. It does not replace missing data with an invented score.

faq.question: Where can I see the full CPL scorecard?
faq.answer: Use the Open full match centre button for the selected fixture. Individual match pages include the official scorecard and ball-by-ball match-centre window.
